description: just verify implementer (scripts/verify.nu) classifies test-file-touched from the tracked diff only: a NEW untracked test file (e.g. crates/seeds/tests/dedupe.rs, run 01M324AZVMHDSCSAMVP4WTZR1R) is invisible to it, so it runs only a compile check and skips the crate suite; implementers must apply the policy manually (cargo nextest run -p <crate>) whenever they add a test file that git does not yet track.
resolution: Manual: run cargo nextest run -p <crate> for any crate whose test files were added but are still untracked; durable fix belongs in scripts/verify.nu diff derivation (include untracked files).
